title: Period Share on Rental Upgrade Difference Charges
content:
**Rule.** The period share of a Rental Property Service Contracts upgrade difference charge follows where in its billing period the upgrade fell, measured by the days left after the upgrade — the calendar days after the upgrade date and before the start of the first billing period at the new tier:

| Days left after the upgrade | Period share |
|---|---|
| 23 or more | the full monthly difference is charged for that period: share one |
| 7 or fewer | a one-week minimum: 7 days divided by 30 is charged for that period, whatever the days left |
| 8 to 22 | the days left divided by 30 |

The share multiplies the monthly difference; the charge is rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Boundaries

| Days left | Share |
|---|---|
| 1 | 7 divided by 30 (the one-week minimum) |
| 7 | 7 divided by 30 (the one-week minimum) |
| 8 | 8 divided by 30 |
| 22 | 22 divided by 30 |
| 23 | one |

*Hypothetical:* an upgrade on 20 April with the first period at the new tier starting 15 May leaves 24 days (21 April to 14 May): the full monthly difference is charged. An upgrade on 11 May with the first period at the new tier starting 15 May leaves 3 days (12 to 14 May): the one-week minimum of 7 divided by 30 is charged.
